description: E0 baseline: the 10 user scenarios a working AuraLite ecosystem must serve (docs/ecosystem/e0-baseline-report.md). Status vocabulary: ready | not-ready. E2's gate turns the list green; E0 proves the checklist itself is complete and honest (0/10 so far).

scenarios.title: Create and protect a wallet
scenarios.need: create or import a wallet, encrypt keys on disk and never expose the seed

scenarios.title: Send and receive AURA
scenarios.need: transfer funds with the fee shown before signing and a clear result after

scenarios.title: See balance and history
scenarios.need: look up an account balance and past transactions without trusting a third party

scenarios.title: Follow a transaction to finality
scenarios.need: submit a transaction and watch it reach finality with unambiguous status

scenarios.title: Inspect validators and consensus health
scenarios.need: see the validator set, participation and finality health of the network

scenarios.title: Get testnet funds from a faucet
scenarios.need: request testnet AURA with rate limits and no manual begging

scenarios.title: Deploy and verify a contract
scenarios.need: deploy a contract and verify its source so others can read what runs

scenarios.title: Build with an SDK
scenarios.need: integrate via Rust, TypeScript or Python SDK examples that pass in CI

scenarios.title: Stake, delegate and track rewards
scenarios.need: delegate to a validator and see rewards and slashing outcomes

scenarios.title: Verify releases and report incidents
scenarios.need: verify signed releases and know exactly how to report a security problem
